summary: Browse and search arXiv, keep preprints, and read their HTML versions on your Kobo.
release_notes: Adds a page description so the app directory listing reads properly in search results.
page_description: Browse a subject's newest arXiv preprints or search the archive, then read the abstract and the paper's HTML rendering on the panel instead of downloading a PDF. Keep preprints for offline reading on your Kobo.
